tools.name: calculate_cac_fees
tools.description: CAC's official registration fees, line by line, for a business name, a limited company (by authorised share capital, default ₦1,000,000) or an NGO (Incorporated Trustees). Use it for any question about what CAC charges to register. These are government fees, not FastCAC's price.

tools.name: check_annual_returns
tools.description: For a CAC business name: which annual returns are due from its registration date, which are overdue, CAC's estimated charge, and when the next one is due. Needs the registration date (it's on the certificate). Without it, the annual returns checker on fastcac.com looks the date up by BN number.

tools.name: check_business_name_compliance
tools.description: Run a proposed business name and its exact CAC line of business through CAC's own compliance and similarity checker. tools.name: get_cac_tax_id

tools.description: Where a request from start_nin_request stands: status (waiting_for_person, started, settling, verified, failed, expired, paid, delivered, delivery_failed), next_step in words, the products and their naira prices. Never the NIN or the person's details: those go only to the person.

tools.description: Ask CAC now for the latest on a registration that's with them (submitted or queried). Changes arrive as system events too.

tools.name: request_payment

tools.description: Turn on or off the 'review the details' section on a business's live status link.

tools.name: show_share_link
tools.description: Show a Copy button for a business's live share link.

tools.name: switch_workspace
tools.description: Switch the dashboard between their Personal workspace (their own businesses) and the Agent workspace (businesses they register for clients; needs the subscription).

tools.name: update_notification_preferences
tools.description: Turn update channels on or off. Only pass the ones they asked to change.

tools.name: update_profile

Only these fields can be set: proposedOption1 (Proposed business name), lineOfBusiness (Line of business (exact CAC picklist entry)), proprietorPhonenumber (Phone number (digits only)), proprietorEmail (Email), proprietorState (State), propr

tools.description: Use the photo from their confirmed NIN record as the passport photograph instead of uploading one. Only after they agree, and only once their NIN is confirmed.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_notification_preferences, list_notifications, mark_notifications_read · Private data: delete_business, fetch_nin_slip, get_action_status, get_cac_documents, get_registration_state, recheck_documents, request_documents, use_nin_photo_for_passport · Public sink: calculate_cac_fees, check_name_availability, create_share_link, get_notification_preferences, list_share_links, recheck_documents, request_documents, revoke_share_link, set_share_review, show_share_link, update_registration_fields · Destructive: check_business_name_compliance, delete_business, recheck_documents, remove_discount_code, remove_whatsapp.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_notification_preferences, list_notifications, mark_notifications_read · Private data: delete_business, fetch_nin_slip, get_action_status, get_cac_documents, get_registration_state, recheck_documents, request_documents, use_nin_photo_for_passport · Public sink: calculate_cac_fees, check_name_availability, create_share_link, get_notification_preferences, list_share_links, recheck_documents, request_documents, revoke_share_link, set_share_review, show_share_link, update_registration_fields · Destructive: check_business_name_compliance, delete_business, recheck_documents, remove_discount_code, remove_whatsapp

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
